BTLCMD 0x38 decodes a byte attack operand (immediate or expression) and emits QueueEnemyAttack; SV_Target reads and ATB/counter queueing stay host-owned

MESA 0x95 and MESAN 0x96 decode an object talker, a byte window id, a byte UI flag list, and a signed 16-bit text id (each an immediate or expression; a negative object is an error) and emit ShowObjectWindow; MESA then waits on the window like WindowSync while MESAN continues

SPS2 0xDA decodes a byte sps id, a byte parameter type, a byte first argument, and two signed 16-bit values (each an immediate or expression) and emits RunSpsCode; the field/battle/world SPS engines stay host-owned

MOVA 0x24 decodes an object operand (immediate or expression; a negative object is an error), requires the current actor, emits WalkTowardObject, and waits on the host movement query like MOVE; following the target stays host-owned

NOINITMES 0x53, BGCLOCK 0x73, BGCUNLOCK 0x74, RESETMAPNAME 0xB1, and DELETEALLCARD 0xAF are operand-less and emit PreventWindowInit, LockCameraFollow, UnlockCameraFollow, ResetFieldName, and DeleteAllCards; window, camera-follow, field-name, and card-deck state stay host-owned
DDIR 0x87 decodes an object plus a byte angle and emits TurnObjectToAngle for that object; DRET 0x97 decodes an object and emits ReturnEntryFunctions; entry-state reset stays host-owned
DWAITTURN 0xBC and DWAITANIM 0xBE decode an object operand and wait on the existing turn/animation host queries for that object via new target-carrying wait states
BTLSEQ 0xE5 decodes a byte attack operand and emits QueueSpecialAttack; SV_Target reads and battle-state checks stay host-owned
DISCCHANGE 0xAC decodes a signed 16-bit field/disc destination (immediate or expression) and emits ChangeDisc with the raw value; map/disc splitting and presentation stay host-owned

BSFLAG 0x103, BSALGO 0x106, BSAXIS 0x108, and BAFRAME 0x10A decode two byte operands and BSDELTA 0x107 a byte plus two signed 16-bit operands (each an immediate or expression), emitting SetSimulationFlags, SetSimulationAlgorithm, SetSimulationAxis, ShowNavigationAnimationFrame, and SetSimulationDelta; the BGI simulation engine stays host-owned
